researchResults.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
researchResults.description: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

researchResults.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
researchResults.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

researchResults.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
researchResults.description: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.

researchResults.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
researchResults.description: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
